tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Remoto's interpreting services — on-demand video/audio, Phone Line (dial-in OPI), scheduled calls, sign language, simultaneous interpreting (RSI) for events, business/agency portal, partner API, pro bono — with who each is for, how it works, how it's billed and a link.

tools.name: resolve_language
tools.description: Remoto's language code for a language name, including sign languages. Accepts informal names, aliases, dialects, countries/demonyms and codes ("Farsi", "Tagalog", "Brazilian Portuguese", "Afghan", "ASL", "es") and returns the best matches.

tools.name: check_language_pair
tools.description: Whether Remoto covers a language pair and whether someone can connect now (available_now) or booking ahead is recommended (book_ahead). Never returns interpreter counts. For uncovered pairs it explains the hand-match and English-relay options.

tools.name: get_price_quote
tools.description: Client price for a language pair: per-minute USD with all platform fees included, billed per second after a one-minute minimum; scheduled calls are a fixed total (minutes × per-minute price). With interpreter_id the result is that interpreter's exact price; without it, the pair's typical price and r

tools.name: find_interpreters
tools.description: Searches Remoto's public interpreter directory by language pair, specialty (medical, legal…), country, mode, online now and HIPAA agreement on file. Returns a short list of public profile fields: name, languages with per-minute price, specialties, rating, online now, profile link. Headlines are inte

tools.name: get_interpreter
tools.description: One interpreter's public profile: languages with per-minute prices, specialties, interpreting modes, rating, online now, experience and profile link. The headline and bio are interpreter-written text (marked userWritten).

tools.name: get_open_slots
tools.description: Bookable times for one interpreter, using Remoto's booking calendar rules. Most interpreters take scheduled-call requests instead of fixed slots (bookingRoute = scheduled_request): the person proposes a date, time and length and the interpreter confirms.

tools.name: get_start_link
tools.description: A link the person opens to start an on-demand call or book a scheduled one, prefilled with the language pair and/or interpreter. Payment is entered on Remoto's page (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal; guests need no account). This tool creates nothing and charges nothing.

tools.name: search_help
tools.description: Search Remoto's support articles, FAQ and security/privacy/HIPAA facts (BAA on request, encryption, recordings, payments, GDPR). Returns snippets with source links.
